sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: STG MID-UPPER LEVEL SPEED MAX AND ATTENDANT LOW-AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE TROUGH -- NOW EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY APCHG NRN CA COAST -- ARE FCST TO MOVE SEWD ACROSS CA/GREAT BASIN DURING PERIOD...LEADING TO HEIGHT FALLS AND AMPLIFICATION OF TROUGHING ACROSS WRN CONUS. DURING 25/00Z-25/12Z TIME FRAME...RESULTANT TROUGH SHOULD MOVE EWD FROM UT/AZ ACROSS NM AND MUCH OF CO...REACHING CENTRAL/SRN HIGH PLAINS BY END OF PERIOD. FOREGOING/WEAKER SHORTWAVE TROUGH -- NOW APPARENT OVER SERN CA/WRN AZ/NWRN SONORA REGION -- WILL MOVE NEWD TO NEAR TX PANHANDLE AND PERMIAN BASIN REGIONS BY LATE AFTERNOON. AHEAD OF THIS PROCESS...BROAD BELT OF SW FLOW ALOFT WILL EXTEND FROM SRN HIGH PLAINS TO MID-ATLANTIC STATES...LARGELY PARALLEL TO PERSISTENT SFC FRONT. FRONTAL ZONE SHOULD REMAIN ACROSS CORRIDOR FROM NJ AND CENTRAL APPALACHIANS SWWD ACROSS KY...AR...SERN OK AND N TX. EFFECTIVE FRONTAL ZONE MAY BE SHUNTED SWD ANYWHERE ALONG ITS EXTENT BY MCS OUTFLOWS. BY MID-LATE AFTERNOON...FRONT/DRYLINE INTERSECTION SHOULD RESIDE IN GEN AREA BETWEEN ABI SPS WITH DRYLINE SWD TOWARD SERRANIAS DEL BURRO AREA OF NRN COAHUILA.

sections.title: TX/OK/AR PORTION OF OUTLOOK AREA -- DRYLINE/FRONT
sections.text: TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP DURING AFTERNOON ALONG FRONT AND DRYLINE...BECOMING MORE DENSE/NUMEROUS OVER FRONT GIVEN NEARLY PARALLEL NATURE OF MEAN WIND AND DEEP-SHEAR VECTORS...LEADING TO EARLY TRANSITION TO MESSY CONVECTIVE MODES. MORE ORTHOGONAL COMPONENT OF FLOW ALOFT ACROSS DRYLINE...COMPARED TO COLD FRONT...SHOULD SUPPORT MORE DISCRETE STORMS...INCLUDING SUPERCELLS...FROM NEAR TRIPLE POINT SWD. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD PRODUCE LARGE HAIL...WITH HAILSTONES AOA 2.75 INCH DIAMETER LIKELY IN A FEW SUPERCELLS. ENHANCED SRH AND DEEP-LAYER SHEAR ALONG THAT PART OF FRONT NEAR DRYLINE MAY AID TORNADO POTENTIAL...WHICH ALSO WILL EXIST SOMEWHAT SWD AHEAD OF DRYLINE INTO EARLY EVENING AS LLJ ENLARGES 0-1 KM AGL HODOGRAPHS. INCREASING HEIGHT FALLS...DCVA...AND STRENGTHENING 500-250 MB LAYER WINDS ARE ALL EXPECTED OVER WRN PORTIONS OF THIS REGION DURING AFTERNOON AHEAD OF EJECTING SHORTWAVE TROUGH...CONCURRENT WITH STG SFC HEATING AND FAVORABLE BUOYANCY. MLCAPE 2500-3000 J/KG IS POSSIBLE...AMIDST 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR. GRADUAL NWD SHIFT IN GREATEST CONVECTIVE CONCENTRATION AGAIN IS LIKELY OVERNIGHT...AS STG LOW-LEVEL WAA AND ISENTROPIC ASCENT TO LFC OCCUR N OF SFC FRONT. MAIN CONCERN N OF

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: NO MAJOR CHANGES TO PREVIOUS OUTLOOK. A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT WILL REMAIN THROUGH THE PERIOD FROM CENTRAL/N CENTRAL TX NEWD TO THE OH VALLEY. ALOFT...A BELT OF MODERATE SWLY FLOW WILL BE MAINTAINED OVER THE FRONT FROM THE SRN PLAINS TO THE OH VALLEY AND NE STATES...DOWNSTREAM FROM A TROUGH THAT WILL MOVE EWD FROM UT/AZ THIS MORNING TO THE SRN HIGH PLAINS BY EARLY MONDAY. THE FRONT HAS BEEN AUGMENTED BY MULTIPLE CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS DURING THE PAST 24 HOURS...AND CONVECTIVE OUTFLOWS WILL KEEP THE EFFECTIVE FOCUS FOR NEW SURFACE-BASED CONVECTION A LITTLE S OF THE FORECAST POSITION OF THE SYNOPTIC FRONT ACROSS THE OH VALLEY REGION.

sections.title: AR/SE OK/N TX AREA THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: WIDESPREAD ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS NE OK THIS MORNING WILL LIKELY PERSIST THROUGH THE DAY AND SPREAD EWD/DEVELOP SWD AND REINFORCE THE FRONT FROM NRN AR INTO N TX. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST ELEVATED CONVECTION. S OF THE FRONT...A FEED OF MID 60S TO LOW 70S BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS WILL CONTINUE ACROSS TX AND THE LOWER MS VALLEY. SIMILAR TO THE PAST COUPLE OF DAYS...THE RELATIVELY SHALLOW NATURE OF THE MARINE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL ALLOW SOME INLAND MIXING OF MOISTURE DURING THE AFTERNOON...BUT AT LEAST MID 60S DEWPOINTS WILL HOLD IN THE ZONE OF LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE/ASCENT ALONG THE STALLED FRONT. THIS MOISTURE WILL BE OVERSPREAD BY AN EML WITH MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AOA 7.5 C/KM...ESPECIALLY OVER SW AR/SE OK/N TX PORTION OF THE OUTLOOK AREA. THE NET RESULT WILL BE ANOTHER DAY OF MLCAPE IN THE 2500-3500 J/KG RANGE ALONG AND IMMEDIATELY SE OF THE FRONT. THE MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-50 KT WILL AGAIN SUPPORT SUPERCELLS IN BROKEN BANDS ALONG THE FRONT THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING...WITH CONVECTION AGAIN LIKELY TO TRAIN ALONG THE BOUNDARY. THE DRYLINE WILL BE SUPPRESSED SWD INTO EDWARDS PLATEAU REGION OF TX. AT LEAST ISOLATED THUNDERST

sections.title: OH VALLEY INTO THE MID ATLANTIC THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: THE SYNOPTIC FRONT IS LOCATED N OF THE OH RIVER...WHILE A COUPLE OF WEAKENING/DISSIPATING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS ARE LOCATED S OF THE FRONT FROM WV TO CENTRAL KY. OUTFLOW WITH THIS CONVECTION...ALONG WITH REMNANT MCV/S AND DAYTIME HEATING IN CLOUD BREAKS...WILL SUPPORT ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT TODAY ALONG THE SAME CORRIDOR AS THE PAST TWO DAYS. ASIDE FROM LOCALLY HEAVY RAINFALL...ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY CONCERN WITH STORM CLUSTERS MOVING ALONG THE FRONT/OUTFLOWS...WITHIN A BELT OF 500-1500 J/KG MLCAPE AND THE SRN FRINGE OF THE STRONGER MIDLEVEL FLOW. ..THOMPSON/COHEN.. 04/24/2011

sections.title: OK/AR/MO
sections.text: A RATHER COMPLEX FORECAST SCENARIO IS UNFOLDING TODAY OVER THIS REGION. A LARGE MCS IS CURRENTLY AFFECTING CENTRAL/EASTERN OK...BUT IS EXPECTED TO DRIFT EASTWARD ACROSS NORTHWEST AR/SOUTHERN MO TODAY. IN THE WAKE OF THIS ACTIVITY...WEAK LOW LEVEL CYCLOGENESIS IS OCCURRING OVER THE SOUTHERN PLAINS. THIS WILL HELP TO LIFT THE SURFACE BOUNDARY NORTHWARD INTO EASTERN OK AND WESTERN/NORTHERN AR BY EVENING. SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS ARE ALSO FORECAST TO STRENGTHEN THROUGH THE EVENING AS THE WESTERN TROUGH SLOWLY APPROACHES. THIS WILL RESULT IN A CORRIDOR OF SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL FROM SOUTHEAST OK INTO SOUTHERN MO. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT THE ONGOING MCS MAY REINTENSIFY LATER THIS AFTERNOON OVER NORTHEAST AR...SPREADING ACROSS THE MID MS VALLEY WITH A RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. HOWEVER...THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT TODAY SHOULD BE NEAR THE SURFACE BOUNDARY OVER EASTERN OK/WESTERN AR/SOUTHWEST MO. NAM/RUC FORECAST SOUNDINGS FOR THIS EVENING SHOW EFFECTIVE HELICITY VALUES OF 300-500 M2/S2 IN THIS AREA...ALONG WITH MODERATE INSTABILITY AND STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES. CONDITIONS APPEAR FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT WITH A RISK OF VERY LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WIND

sections.title: OH VALLEY INTO MID ATLANTIC STATES
sections.text: LARGE SCALE FORCING MECHANISMS ARE HARD TO IDENTIFY TODAY EAST OF THE MS RIVER. HOWEVER...SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING THIS MORNING ALONG THE SURFACE BOUNDARY. ALL MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THAT A FEW OF THESE CLUSTERS MAY INTENSIFY THIS AFTERNOON WITH A RISK OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS. THIS THREAT WILL LIKELY BE MODULATED BY THE EXTENT OF LOCAL HEATING/DESTABILIZATION. AS SUCH...THE CLUSTER MOVING ACROSS WV MAY HAVE THE BEST POTENTIAL FOR REJUVENATION AS IT CROSS THE MOUNTAINS AND APPROACHES THE DELMARVA REGION. ..HART/GARNER.. 04/24/2011

sections.title: TX/OK
sections.text: EARLY AFTERNOON SURFACE ANALYSIS COMBINED WITH SATELLITE AND RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A TSTM HAD DEVELOPED INVOF A COLD FRONT/DRY LINE INTERSECTION...10 W ABI...WITH ADDITIONAL CU/TCU FORMING ALONG THE AFOREMENTIONED BOUNDARIES. GIVEN THE LOCATION OF BOUNDARIES WITHIN MODERATE-VERY STRONG INSTABILITY /MLCAPE 1500-3000 J PER KG/ ACROSS THE TX WARM SECTOR AND CONTINUED DESTABILIZATION OVER SRN TO ERN OK...SEVERE PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN EXPANDED WWD OVER WRN N TX AND NWD OVER ERN OK.

sections.title: NRN TX PANHANDLE/FAR NERN NM TO FAR SERN CO
sections.text: DESPITE SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE MID-UPPER 30S...AN INCREASE IN ESELY LOW LEVEL WINDS WITH THE APPROACH OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW LOCATED OVER THE FOUR CORNERS REGION AND ATTENDANT MIDLEVEL COOLING WITH THIS SYSTEM SHOULD SUPPORT TSTMS. MODELS SUGGEST THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD DEVELOP OR MOVE EWD INTO THIS DISCUSSION AREA BY 25/00Z. MIDLEVEL COLD ADVECTION/STEEPENING LAPSE RATES ACCOMPANYING THE FOUR CORNERS SYSTEM REACHING THE SRN HIGH PLAINS JUST AFTER PEAK HEATING SHOULD RESULT IN MLCAPE TO AROUND 500 J/KG. THIS COMBINED WITH INCREASING EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR /25-40 KT/ SUGGESTS A FEW ORGANIZED STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE...WITH MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES 8-9 C/KM SUPPORTING HAIL...SOME POTENTIALLY REACHING SEVERE LEVELS. SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY WILL BE HIGH BASED WHICH WOULD SUPPORT A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS AS WELL. THUS...5% AREAS FOR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS HAVE BEEN INTRODUCED IN THE 20Z OUTLOOK.

sections.title: MID-ATLANTIC STATES
sections.text: SLIGHT RISK AREA HAS BEEN EXPANDED ACROSS THIS REGION GIVEN A DESTABILIZING AIR MASS AND STRONG EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED STORMS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION...REFER TO MESOSCALE DETAILS DESCRIBED IN SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 549 AND SEVERE TSTM WATCH 195 FOR THIS REGION.

sections.title: PART OF NERN TN/SERN KY
sections.text: SEVERE PROBABILITIES AND SLIGHT RISK AREA HAVE BEEN EXTENDED ACROSS THESE AREAS GIVEN ONGOING CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS MOVING EWD ACROSS NRN TN/SOUTH CENTRAL-SERN KY...AND ADDITIONAL STORMS DEVELOPING IN ADVANCE OF THE STRONGER ACTIVITY. ..PETERS.. 04/24/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1058 AM CDT SUN APR 24 2011/ BROAD CYCLONIC FLOW IS PRESENT TODAY OVER THE WESTERN STATES...WHILE A STRONG TROUGH DIGS SOUTHEASTWARD INTO THE PACIFIC COAST REGION. ON THE EAST SIDE OF THE TROUGH...SOUTHWEST FLOW ALOFT WILL ONCE AGAIN AFFECT THE CENTRAL/EASTERN STATES. THE PRIMARY FOCUS FOR STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL ONCE AGAIN BE ALONG A CONVECTIVELY REINFORCED SURFACE BOUNDARY FROM TX/OK INTO THE MID ATLANTIC STATES.

sections.text: LARGE SCALE FORCING MECHANISMS ARE HARD TO IDENTIFY TODAY EAST OF THE MS RIVER. HOWEVER...SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING THIS MORNING ALONG THE SURFACE BOUNDARY. sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER A PORTION OF MD/DE/NJ
sections.text: ...CNTRL TX NEWD INTO AR AND WRN TN/KY... STRONG SHEAR PROFILES WILL REMAIN IN PLACE ACROSS THE ENTIRE REGION AS THE UPPER HEIGHT FALLS PERSIST ALONG WITH A STRONG SWLY LOW LEVEL JET. STORMS ACROSS ERN OK INTO AR WILL HAVE A HAIL...WIND...AND TORNADO THREAT FOR A FEW MORE HOURS BUT THE 00Z LZK SOUNDING SUGGESTS POOR LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND INCREASING CIN MAY BECOME AN ISSUE. FOR MORE INFORMATION REFERENCE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 557. ALL MODES OF SEVERE WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH THE CELLS OVER N CNTRL TX THIS EVENING. WITH TIME...CIN IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE ACROSS NRN TX...THEREFORE...ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT MAY BE LESS PROBABLE WITH TIME...BUT CURRENT ACTIVITY MAY REMAIN ORGANIZED FOR A FEW HOURS.

sections.title: DELMARVA
sections.text: A MARGINAL HAIL/WIND THREAT WILL PERSIST WITH ISOLATED ACTIVITY ACROSS THE AREA FOR A FEW MORE HOURS BEFORE MOVING OFFSHORE AND/OR THE ATMOSPHERE BECOMES MORE STABLE. RADAR TRENDS SHOW MAINLY SMALL HAIL WITH THE STRONGER CORES...BUT A FEW GUSTY WINDS MAY OCCUR AS WELL. FOR MORE INFORMATION...SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 559.

sections.title: ERN OK/TX PANHANDLES INTO WRN AND CNTRL OK LATE TONIGHT
sections.text: UPPER LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS/COOLING WILL OVERSPREAD THE REGION...STEEPENING MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES. AT THE SAME TIME...A SLY LOW LEVEL JET WILL STRENGTHEN...AND WILL BRING HIGHER THETA-E AIR NWD ACROSS N TX INTO MUCH OF OK. THIS WILL CREATE VERY STRONG ELEVATED INSTABILITY LATE TONIGHT...AND SHEAR PROFILES WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR PERHAPS ELEVATED SUPERCELLS WITH VERY LARGE HAIL. THERE ARE QUESTIONS ABOUT COVERAGE OF SEVERE...BUT MODEL GUIDANCE IN GENERAL AGREES THAT LARGE SCALE FORCING WILL RESULT IN AT LEAST SCATTERED STORMS BEGINNING OVER THE OK/TX PANHANDLES AND SPREADING EWD ACROSS OK TONIGHT BETWEEN 06-12Z. CONVECTION WAS ALREADY INCREASING OVER THE NRN TX PANHANDLE AS OF 01Z...ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE UPPER VORT. FOR MORE INFORMATION...REFERENCE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 558. ..JEWELL.. 04/25/2011
